diff --git a/action.yml b/action.yml
index 84469f4..dafa791 100644
--- a/action.yml
+++ b/action.yml
@@ -90,6 +90,22 @@ inputs:
     description: 'Agent directory (user-level state) for pi-durable extensions, relative to the workspace; a fresh temp directory under RUNNER_TEMP when empty'
     required: false
     default: ''
+  exclude_tools:
+    description: 'Tools to disable completely, one per line or comma-separated; * matches any characters (for example bash). Neither the model nor other tools can call them'
+    required: false

+  worktree_snapshots:

+  worktree_snapshot_exclude:
+    description: 'Globs of untracked files never to save in a working-tree snapshot, one per line or comma-separated (for example .env*, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa*). Ignored files are never saved'
+    required: false
+    default: ''
   prompt_template:
     description: 'Custom prompt template with placeholder variables'

@@ -169,13 +185,17 @@ runs:

+        INPUT_EXCLUDE_TOOLS: ${{ inputs.exclude_tools }}
+        INPUT_MODEL_TOOLS_HIDDEN: ${{ inputs.model_tools_hidden }}
+        INPUT_WORKTREE_SNAPSHOTS: ${{ inputs.worktree_snapshots }}

-    # Pushes the thread's refs/pi/threads/<number> if the step above was cancelled, timed out, or crashed
-    # before its own final push. Fast-forward only: it never overwrites another run's history.
+    # Pushes the thread's refs/pi/threads/<number> (and refs/pi/worktrees/<number>) if the step above was cancelled,
+    # timed out, or crashed before its own final push. Fast-forward only: it never overwrites another run's history.
     - name: Save pi thread state
       if: always()
       shell: bash
---

### Added
- **Working-tree continuity** (#33, added in #44). A thread now keeps the files that pi leaves uncommitted, staged and unstaged, on `refs/pi/worktrees/<number>`, and restores them at the start of the next run. When you rewind or fork the conversation, the files rewind too. Two new inputs: `worktree_snapshots` (default `true`) and `worktree_snapshot_exclude`. See [Working-tree continuity](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.3.0/docs/threads.md#working-tree-continuity).
- **A workflow log that shows what pi does** (#46, added in #48, #49, and #50). The log shows one line for each step while pi works: `💬` for the text of the model, `🔧` when a tool call starts, and `↳ ✓` or `↳ ✗ failed` when it ends. Click a `↳` line to see the arguments of the call and the last 30 lines of its output. Each reply gets a `✅ Replied` line with the comment and totals: model responses, tool calls, time, and tokens. The setup is in a collapsed `Setup` group. The thread, with the git commands that read it, is now at the start of the log. Pushes and working-tree snapshots are debug messages: to see them, enable step debug logging. See [The workflow log](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.3.0/docs/how-it-works.md#the-workflow-log).

### Fixed
- **A fetch by pi no longer breaks the run** (#46, fixed in #47). If pi fetched into `refs/pi/*`, for example with `git fetch origin '+refs/pi/*:refs/pi/*'`, it moved the ref that the run was writing to. The session then failed without a reply, a reaction, or a failed step. A run now keeps its refs on `refs/pi-action/*` on the runner, and pushes them to `refs/pi/*` on the remote. See [Protection against conflicts](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.3.0/docs/threads.md#protection-against-conflicts).
- **A failed session is reported** (#46, fixed in #47). If the storage of the thread fails, pi-action posts a `❌ pi Error` comment with the cause, adds 😕 to the request, and fails the step.
- **No false warning from `Save pi thread state`** (#46, fixed in #47). If the remote already has the local commits, the step writes `already saved` to the log, not a warning.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pi-action/compare/v2.2.2...v2.3.0
